terms.gloss: a runaway slave, a fugitive, a deserter; as an adjective (fugitīvus, -a, -um), runaway
evidence: Hor. S. 2.7.113: tēque ipsum vītās fugitīvus et errō (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: neque tam fugitīvī illī ab dominīs quam tū ab jūre et ab lēgibus
phrases.english: nor were they so much runaways from their masters as you from justice and the laws
